text:
customer:juno-ai: Hey team — since ~08:00 UTC our app started getting 429s from the dedicated pool. Error payload: "rate_limit_exceeded". This is across gen and embeddings, region eu-west-1. Console shows our tenant quota as 0. Any ideas?

elyse: Sorry about that — can you confirm the dedicated pool id and tenant id? Also, did you change plan or keys recently?

customer:juno-ai: pool: dedicated-eu-4, tenant: juno-ai. No plan changes. We did rotate KMS keys last week (asked infra to do a key rotation), but we were told that blobs are re-encrypted automatically.

sre-oncall: I'm pulling control-plane logs now. Quick check: saw repeated KMS decrypt errors when loading per-tenant quota blobs for juno-ai: 
```
2026-03-16T08:12:34Z ERROR quota-loader: decryption_failed tenant=juno-ai key_id=old-key-123 err=KMS_DecryptionError
```
If the quota loader can't decrypt we appear to be treating that as an empty quota (0) and forcing throttling. :eyes:

alex: Oof. That's bad. Reproducer (from my test machine):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \ 
  -H "x-tenant-id: juno-ai" \ 
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' -i
# Response: 429 {"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","message":"quota exhausted"}
```

elyse: Thanks, @sre-oncall and @alex. Temporary mitigation: I applied a quota override from the admin console to unblock them while we investigate. Ops-bot recorded it.

ops-bot: Admin action: quota_override applied tenant=juno-ai by=elyse scope=rate_units value=2000000 ttl=24h :white_check_mark:

customer:juno-ai: That got us back to normal, thanks.

alex: Root cause analysis so far: during the KMS rotation a subset of quota blobs remained encrypted with the previous key and the re-encrypt job failed for those objects. The quota-loader code does not distinguish a decryption failure from an intentionally empty/missing quota and defaults to 0.

elyse: Action items: 1) ops will re-run the re-encrypt job for the affected tenant blobs (in progress) 2) engineering will patch quota-loader to fail open to last-known-good value (or retain previous quota) instead of defaulting to 0, and add an alert for decryption failures.

alex: PR landed to change fallback behavior and add unit test: fallback now uses cached quota if decryption fails and emits a critical alert. Patch deployed to control-plane at 09:40 UTC.

ops-bot: Re-encrypt job status: tenant=juno-ai re-encrypt succeeded for 18/18 blobs at 09:02 UTC.

customer:juno-ai: We're stable for the last 30 minutes, no more 429s. Appreciate the fast response.

elyse: Follow-up: added a runbook entry for KMS rotations to validate blob re-encryption and a post-check that alerts if decryption errors > 0 for any tenant.

sre-oncall: Closing this Slack thread — root cause = KMS rotation left stale encrypted quota blobs + fallback bug -> throttle. Fix deployed + ops re-encrypted + temporary override. Please reopen if you see anything else. :thumbsup:
